assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction, raising concern for potential arrhythmia as a contributing factor to cerebrovascular events.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying cardiac activity.
The service is associated with CPT code 93229.
The service addresses the clinical need associated with diagnosis code Z86.73.
The service addresses the clinical need associated with diagnosis code G45.9.
The service addresses the clinical need associated with diagnosis code R00.2.
